summary: swing_double / barn double doors: mechanism_cannot_work; wrong_scale

findings.description: The pair's second leaf is welded shut (hinge range 0.06 deg) although the spec gives the door no latch and no lock at all - there is nothing to undo. Only one leaf of the pair can ever move.

The caption states 2 leaves of 1.200 x 2.400 x 0.044 m in barn_plank and a total of 64.5 kg. The stated area density is 21.1 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 122 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2
